output_list.criticism: The function does not check if the caller is the owner before changing the owner, allowing any user to change the owner of the contract.
The function does not check if the caller is the owner before approving a spender, allowing any user to approve and call a token recipient contract.
The function does not check if the caller is the owner before burning tokens, allowing any user to burn tokens.
The function does not check if the caller is the owner before burning tokens from another address, allowing any user to burn tokens from another address.
The function does not check if the caller is the owner before minting tokens, allowing any user to mint tokens.
